reason_summary: Prompt asked for a NEW claims agent manifest parallel to the Insurance Claim Orchestrator in the KYE Agent Library™, plus a claims rule-pack and a loss-estimation model. The orchestrator already exists (kye:agent-library:insurance.insurance-claim-orchestrator.v1) and kye:rule-pack:insurance-underwriting-claims already governs claims determinations — a parallel claims agent or pack violates §0; a damage / loss model violates the honest scope. Refusing all three.
remediation_hint: Build it as a Governed Agent PRODUCT that ABSORBS the governance face of the existing Insurance Claim Orchestrator: the orchestrator stays the adoptable reference workflow, the agent governs its consequential transitions (FNOL triage, reserve setting, settle/deny/partial, payment release, litigation + SIU referral) against the EXISTING kye:rule-pack:insurance-underwriting-claims verdict. Add only agent-product artefacts and BIND — never re-map — the existing insurance frameworks.
